stem:
Which graph best represents the solution set for the system of inequalities?

\[ y < x + 4 \]

\[ y \leq -2x - 2 \]

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with shaded area below the line y = x + 4 and above the line y = -2x - 2, shaded area in lower left quadrant

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with shaded area above the line y = x + 4 and above the line y = -2x - 2, shaded area in upper left quadrant

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with shaded area below the line y = x + 4 and below the line y = -2x - 2, shaded area in lower left quadrant

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with shaded area above the line y = x + 4 and below the line y = -2x - 2, shaded area in upper right quadrant

visual_elements: Four coordinate plane graphs labeled A, B, C, and D, each with lines and shaded regions corresponding to the inequalities
notes: Graphs show different regions shaded according to the system of inequalities; option A looks to be the correct representation.
